note: A Class 1 poem about a horse. Teach rhyming words that end the same way (like -aal: taal, chaal, daal), hearing the first and the last sound of a word, and the letters त, घ and ड़. Write your own short rhyme and words; never copy the poem's lines. Mix the right answers: at least one question in each lesson has the answer No (नहीं). Ask about घ and ड़ too, not only त. Tag letter lessons read2, sound lessons read1. Keep every question short enough for a Class 1 child to read.
